----------- changelog -----------

0. Rewrote Alsh for eash of use
1. Fix string buffer growth in dependencies/string.c
   - Avoid reallocating on every add_char()/combine_strings()
   - Implement capacity tracking and exponential reserve
2. Improve shell input handling in dependencies/vega.c
   - Prevent current_line from reallocating on every keystroke
   - Batch write operations and reduce repeated string copies
3. Updated kernel_malloc.s with backward merging in kfree()
    - now coalesces both previous and next free blocks to reduce fragmentation.
    - OOM handling is solid: kmalloc returns NULL on failure, and callers handle 
      it gracefully (e.g., by setting length/capacity to 0).
4. Reduce duplicate copy logic across string/filesystem/alsh
   - Add a memcpy/memmove helper
   - Reuse it in break_args(), create(), combine_strings(), etc.
5. integrate "is_empty_string" check
6. Clean up time/keyboard hardware code

7. Implement basic FAT32 filesystem (dependencies/fat.c)
   - Read BPB and initialize FAT layout (fat_start, data_start, root_cluster)
   - Implement cluster_to_lba and rw_cluster helpers
   - Add directory read/write support

8. Add file operations
   - create_file(): allocates cluster, zeroes it, writes directory entry
   - write_file(): writes data to file cluster and updates size
   - read_file(): reads file data from cluster and returns buffer
   - Prevent duplicate file creation via 8.3 name matching

9. Implement FAT cluster management
   - find_free_cluster() scans FAT for free entries
   - write_fat_entry() updates FAT correctly
   - read_fat_entry() used for chain traversal

10. Add file deletion support
    - delete_file(): walks FAT chain and frees all clusters
    - marks directory entry as deleted (0xE5)
    - ensures clusters are reusable after deletion

11. Improve memory safety in filesystem
    - Replace per-function static zero buffers with shared cluster_buffer
    - Add cluster size bounds checking to prevent overflow
    - Prevent invalid cluster access and FAT corruption

12. Expose filesystem API to kernel --> !!TEMPORARY WORK AROUND FOR NOW!!
    - allow create/write/read/delete from outside fat.c
    - use global FAT state (a_bpb, a_fat_start, a_data_start, a_root_cluster)

********* IMPORTANT CHANGES *********

1. update the screen size / ratio
2. removed all calls to VEGA graphics
3. remoed alsh (right after rewritting it.... :/)
   ...maybe ill keep it as a shell in the final product
4. compltely migrated to graphics mode and VBE
